The diagram is at `docs/architecture.png`. The image I opened doesn't show up on your side, so here's what it contains.

It's titled **"Acme dashboard: architecture"** and shows four boxes connected left to right:

```
┌───────┐    ┌────────┐    ┌────────┐    ┌──────┐
│  app  │────│ report │────│ charts │────│  db  │
└───────┘    └────────┘    └────────┘    └──────┘
```

The lines have no arrowheads or labels, so the diagram shows which parts connect but not which way data moves.

To view it yourself, run `open docs/architecture.png`.

There's one other image in the repo, `design notes/login flow.png`. Its name suggests it covers the login flow rather than the architecture.
